Class Archer

java.lang.Object
model.entity.base.CharacterModel
model.entity.base.PlayerCharacter
model.entity.concrete.Archer
public class Archer extends PlayerCharacter
Represents a playable PlayerCharacter of type ARCHER.

The Archer is a ranged fighter who starts with balanced health, good attack power, and high speed, making them effective at striking first during combat. This class also manages the logic for equipping and unequipping a Crossbow.

  • Method Details

    • equipCrossbow

      public void equipCrossbow(Crossbow crossbow)
      Equips the given Crossbow to the Archer. If another Crossbow is already equipped, it is first unequipped automatically.
      Parameters:
      crossbow - the crossbow to equip.

    • unequipCrossbow

      public void unequipCrossbow(Crossbow crossbow)
      Unequips the currently equipped Crossbow, if it matches the given one. If no crossbow is equipped or if the specified crossbow does not match the currently equipped one, the method does nothing.
      Parameters:
      crossbow - the crossbow to unequip.
